findings.passage: While this is not a panacea to fix and solve our gun violence, I think we can all agree that we should do everything in our power as a city to address the impacts.
findings.note: Quoted by a TV station news story while she was a San Francisco supervisor, speaking on two ammunition ordinances she co-sponsored (a ban on possessing certain hollow-point bullets and a notice-to-police rule for purchases of 500+ rounds). The story says the board gave unanimous initial approval.
subjects: limits on ammunition sales and possession

findings.motion: San Francisco ordinances on ammunition: ban on possessing certain hollow-point bullets, and notice to police of purchases of 500+ rounds (co-sponsored with the mayor)
findings.note: A news story reports she co-sponsored two city ordinances limiting certain ammunition; the board gave them unanimous initial approval, with final approval due the next week. Ordinance numbers not confirmed.
